reasoning: According to Congressional Research Service (CRS) records and historical budget data, the last time Congress enacted all regular annual appropriations bills before the start of the fiscal year (October 1) was for Fiscal Year 1997 (enacted in September 1996). Since FY 1998, Congress has failed to pass all regular individual spending bills prior to the October 1 deadline, relying instead on stopgap funding measures (continuing resolutions) and late omnibus spending packages. Therefore, the statement that Congress has not passed a complete federal budget on time since 1997 is accurate.
title: US Congress passed no budget on time since 1997
